ExpansionMain_Expansion01/MRQS_E01_130_T.en: You and Rapunzel head to Rapunzel's Tower, hoping to investigate Mother Gothel's chest of belongings within. Rapunzel seems VERY hesitant to go anywhere near the tower... but why?

ExpansionMain_Expansion01/MRQS_E01_130_T.en: Once banished, Mother Gothel's sand illusion dropped the Jewel of Time! Behind it, you find the real Gothel's chest of precious treasures with Rapunzel's missing paints inside. You return the paints to a grateful Rapunzel, celebrating the fact that you're one step closer to saving Eternity Isle.

Barvy vrátíte vděčné Locice a oslavíte tak, že jste o krok blíž k záchraně Věčného ostrova.

ExpansionMain_Expansion01/MRQS_E01_130_T.en: Rapunzel believes her tower is cursed, claiming she sees Mother Gothel in the window. Despite her fears, she agrees to accompany you inside to help Eternity Isle. You hatch a plan to grow vines to climb into the tower, and set out to find seeds in the Oasis.

Navzdory svým obavám souhlasí, že vás doprovodí dovnitř a pomůže Eternity Isle. Vymyslíte plán, jak vypěstovat popínavé rostliny, abyste se mohli dostat do věže, a vydáte se hledat semínka v Oáze.

ExpansionMain_Expansion01/MRQS_E01_140_E.en: Jafar has tasked you with finding the two Jewels of Time that are still missing from the Hourglass. You won't be able to reach the palace until you do. He suggests you start by exploring the Glittering Dunes and the Wild Tangle. Perhaps you'll find some new Villagers who can help you...

Navrhuje, abyste začali prozkoumáváním Třpytivých dun a Divoké spleti. Možná najdete nějaké nové vesničany, kteří vám pomohou...

ExpansionMain_Expansion01/MRQS_E01_140_E.en: But when you confronted Jafar, you learned his true motivations. Jafar is after an ancient treasure known as the Spark of Imagination. With that, he would have the power to bend all of space and time to his whim. For now, Jafar has vanished... but when he returns, you'll have to be ready to stop his schemes.
ExpansionMain_Expansion01/MRQS_E01_140_E.cz: Ale když jste se postavili Jafarovi, poznali jste jeho skutečné motivy. Jafar touží po starodávném pokladu známém jako Jiskra představivosti. S ní by měl moc ohýbat veškerý prostor a čas podle svého rozmaru. Prozatím Jafar zmizel... ale až se vrátí, budete muset být připraveni zastavit jeho plány.
